items.why: Volatility spikes as the S&P 500 and Dow enter correction and the Nasdaq wipes out its 2026 gain.
Chip names are leading the sell-off as Wall Street forecasters start to worry the AI trade is on its last legs.
Nvidia slides deeper after a report of an SEC accounting probe, and has now lost $2.3 trillion in market value since its October peak.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 4.98% and S&P futures down 3.15% as the AI sell-off continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off hard, with the S&P 500 and Dow in correction and the Nasdaq wiping out its 2026 gain as the AI sell-off deepens. Chip names are leading the slide and volatility is spiking.
